title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
abstract: We present a dense passage retrieval approach that uses dual neural encoders to map questions and passages into a shared embedding space. Experiments show strong recall for open-domain question answering with efficient nearest neighbor search.

title: Contextualized Late Interaction for Efficient Passage Search
abstract: This paper studies contextualized late interaction for passage search. Token-level representations improve ranking quality while preserving efficient offline indexing and online matching for large document collections.

title: Large Language Models are Zero-Shot Reasoners
abstract: We demonstrate that large language models can solve reasoning tasks without task-specific training by using carefully designed prompting and intermediate reasoning steps.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
abstract: We combine a pretrained language model with a dense document retriever so that generation is conditioned on external knowledge. The retrieval augmented generation model improves factual coverage on knowledge intensive natural language processing tasks.

title: Graph Neural Networks for Recommender Systems: A Survey
abstract: This survey reviews graph neural network methods for recommender systems, including user-item graph modeling, message passing, cold-start recommendation, and scalable training.

title: Neural Collaborative Filtering for Recommendation
abstract: We propose a neural collaborative filtering framework that learns user and item interactions for recommendation. Experiments compare matrix factorization with deep interaction models.

title: Evaluating Retrieval Systems with Precision Recall and Mean Reciprocal Rank
abstract: We analyze standard information retrieval evaluation metrics including precision at k, recall at k, mean reciprocal rank, and normalized discounted cumulative gain for reproducible retrieval experiments.

title: BM25 and Beyond: Probabilistic Models for Information Retrieval
abstract: This tutorial explains probabilistic keyword retrieval models, term frequency saturation, document length normalization, and the BM25 ranking function for search engines.

title: Knowledge Graph Embedding for Scientific Literature Discovery
abstract: We learn knowledge graph embeddings from paper citations, authors, and research topics to support scientific literature discovery, related paper search, and concept exploration.

title: Self-Reflective Retrieval Generation and Critique
abstract: We introduce a self-reflective framework in which a language model retrieves evidence, generates an answer, and critiques its own output. The method improves retrieval augmented generation reliability.

title: Lightweight Graph Convolution for Recommendation
abstract: We simplify graph convolution networks for collaborative recommendation. The proposed light graph model reduces training complexity while retaining strong recommendation accuracy.

title: Efficient Neural Ranking with Sparse Representations
abstract: We study sparse neural representations for efficient document ranking. Learned term weights combine the interpretability of keyword search with the effectiveness of neural ranking.

title: Topic Modeling and Trend Mining in Scientific Publications
abstract: We apply topic modeling to scientific publication collections and analyze research trends across time. The system helps users discover emerging topics and representative papers.

title: Citation-Aware Scientific Paper Recommendation
abstract: We propose a citation-aware recommendation model for scientific paper discovery. Citation context and bibliographic signals are used to recommend relevant literature.

title: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Scientific Question Answering
abstract: We build a benchmark for evaluating large language models on scientific question answering and evidence retrieval. Results reveal strengths and failure modes in research literature assistance.

title: Query Expansion and Pseudo-Relevance Feedback for Keyword Search
abstract: We investigate query expansion and pseudo relevance feedback for keyword search. Expanded terms improve recall for short and ambiguous search queries.

title: Semantic Search over Scientific Literature with Dense Embeddings
abstract: We construct dense embeddings of paper titles and abstracts for semantic search over scientific literature. The system supports natural language discovery and related-paper exploration.

title: A Survey of Retrieval Evaluation Metrics for Search Engines
abstract: This survey compares retrieval evaluation metrics including recall, precision, mean average precision, reciprocal rank, and user-oriented measures for keyword search engines.
